verdict.rationale: EFTPS's own docs describe a sanctioned third-party rail: tax professionals can make payments for multiple clients under one login, a Batch Provider Software program exists, and businesses are pointed to tax professionals or payroll providers who make payments on their behalf. The documentation stays at that high level and never explains how the company grants, scopes or revokes that authority. Missing for 10: documented authorization/enrollment steps for designating a provider, scope and revocation controls over provider access, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: If you're a tax professional, you can make payments for multiple clients under a single login.
Download the free Batch Provider Software.
consult a tax professional or payroll provider about making payments for you
